partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Anatomy-supported GOF parent transfer
results.hypothesis: GOF mechanism transfer to a broader disease is more credible when the gene is expressed in anatomy affected by the broader disease.
results.body: R178 plus Bgee expression of directional gene in candidate parent anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: Affected anatomy independently supports relevance to the broader disease, but ontology transfer can still overgeneralize.
results.trapi_notes: Positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; Bgee provenance, shared anatomy, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(anchor:Disease)
MATCH (anchor)-[:SUBCLASS_OF]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Gene-corroborated GOF parent transfer
results.hypothesis: GOF mechanism transfer to a broader disease is more credible when the same gene has independent top-ranked disease evidence for that parent.
results.body: R178 plus independent top-three gene-disease evidence to candidate parent
results.mechanism_rationale: The broader disease is supported by an independent gene-disease evidence synthesis while explicit GOF direction comes from the specific child.
results.trapi_notes: Positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; evidence rank, source, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
